# Sriram V

> Sriram V is an AI Engineer at Madras MindWorks Pvt Ltd in Chennai, India. His work focuses on Generative AI, large language model (LLM) applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, and AI product development.

## Selected work
- RamayanaAI: an offline knowledge assistant project exploring RAG and local language models.
- Electrical Competency Assessment: an interactive, scenario-based 3D training experience.
- The SUPER Repo: developer tooling and runtime-orchestration experiments.
- Apex Pursuit: Redline Protocol: a browser-based 3D racing game prototype.
